tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the user's projects (their own and shared ones they are a member of) with the number of open tasks in each. Archived projects are left out unless include_archived is true.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks with filters. view: all (default), inbox (no project), today (open tasks due today or overdue, overdue first) or upcoming (open tasks due after today). Tasks of archived projects are left out unless project_id names that project. Results are paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous result, to get the following page.

due_from.description: Only tasks due on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

due_to.description: Only tasks due on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

label.description: Only tasks carrying this label (name, case-insensitive, or id).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default and maximum 200).

priority.description: Only tasks of this priority: 1 is the highest, 4 the default.

project_id.description: Only tasks of this project (see list_projects).

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to decide what is today, overdue or upcoming, e.g. "Europe/Rome". Default: UTC. Due dates are floating, so pass the user's zone.

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Get one task with its description, project, section, labels, subtasks and comments.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to decide what is today, overdue or upcoming, e.g. "Europe/Rome". Default: UTC. Due dates are floating, so pass the user's zone.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.title: Search tasks
tools.description: Find tasks whose title or description contains the query (case-insensitive). Open tasks only unless include_completed is true. Paged like list_tasks.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous result, to get the following page.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default and maximum 200).

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to decide what is today, overdue or upcoming, e.g. "Europe/Rome". Default: UTC. Due dates are floating, so pass the user's zone.

tools.name: today_summary
tools.title: Today summary
tools.description: One-call overview of the user's day: overdue tasks, tasks due today, and open task counts for the inbox and each project.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to decide what is today, overdue or upcoming, e.g. "Europe/Rome". Default: UTC. Due dates are floating, so pass the user's zone.
